page.overview:
Who is Alisa Bosconovitch?

Alisa is an android created by Doctor Bosconovitch in the Bosconovitch Laboratory, a Mishima Zaibatsu facility that served as a hub for the organization’s military equipment development.

Doctor Bosconovitch was later kidnapped by Kazuya Mishima and made head of the Mishima Zaibatsu’s research and development division, where he worked on perpetual engine technology and cold sleep machines. He used the latter technology to preserve the body of his deceased daughter. Doctor Bosconovitch was later liberated from the Mishima Zaibatsu by Yoshimitsu, who funded Bosconovitch’s continued development of the cold sleep technology.

At some point after the King of Iron Fist Tournament 5, Doctor Bosconovitch began working for the Mishima Zaibatsu (now under the control of Jin Kazama) again. In this time, he was able to complete the android replica of his daughter that he had begun developing years before. Alisa was created to be a bodyguard for Jin; she was programmed with advanced combat abilities and equipped with built-in weaponry to make her suitable for this task.

During the war between the Mishima Zaibatsu and G Corporation, Lars Alexandersson raided the Bosconovitch Laboratory with a squad of his rebel army. During the raid, he discovered Alisa ‘asleep’ in a pod. G Corporation also infiltrated the lab at this time and attacked Lars’s squad, killing everyone but Lars and leaving Lars with a head injury that resulted in amnesia. As he rose from the ground after the attack, Lars activated Alisa’s pod, awakening her. The two took out the remaining G Corp enemies and then escaped the collapsing lab together. Alisa was reluctant to leave, as her ‘father had told her to stay there’.
